inferred_creative_thinking.insight: Getting government certificates (resident registration, income proof) usually means a trip to the community service center or a clunky government website with certificates and login hurdles - most people do not know a fintech app can issue them, let alone bundle several at once
inferred_creative_thinking.persona: A 20s-30s mobile-native Korean adult assembling paperwork for a jeonse (lease) loan, who would rather not visit a 주민센터 or wrestle with a government portal
inferred_creative_thinking.moment: The realization that the financial super-app already trusted for money can also issue official civil documents - and bundle the exact set a lease loan requires in one tap
inferred_creative_thinking.product_role: The super-app absorbs a government-administrative errand: it surfaces a '증명서 발급하기' service, offers ready-made document bundles per use-case, issues several certificates at once, and lets the user view or export each as a PDF
inferred_creative_thinking.punchline: With Toss you do not have to go to the community center - the documents come to you, bundled and ready
inferred_creative_thinking.differentiator: Pre-packaged certificate bundles per real-life need (lease loan, credit loan, employment) plus simultaneous multi-document issuance and instant PDF export, all inside the app you already use for finance
inferred_creative_thinking.brand_fit_one_liner: A fintech that earns trust by quietly swallowing the most tedious bureaucratic errands of adult life

inferred_brief: Create a ~52-second vertical short-form how-to that hooks with a 'did you know Toss has a community service center inside it?' question over a playful live-action presenter, then walks through the Toss 증명서 발급하기 feature via annotated top-down phone screen-recording - showing the certificate list, a lease-loan document bundle, simultaneous issuance of three certificates, and PDF export - closing on a clean Curator T brand sticker.
analyst_notes: 12 shots after cross-checking scenedetect macro-scenes against per-frame diff spikes and reading 129 native-res staged frames. Real hard cuts confirmed at f42(1.37, diff73), f108(3.57, diff65), f186(6.17, diff47), f302(10.04, diff75), f422(14.05, diff62), f569(18.95, diff89), f660(21.99, diff82), f757(25.23, diff65), f830(27.66, diff67), f1287/f1303(42.91, diff41/37 = in-app PDF-viewer modal opening within the same flat-phone screen recording, kept as the scene-11/12 structural boundary), f1501(50.05, diff113 = cut to Curator T endcard). The scenedetect 8.81 boundary (f265, diff44) is a sub-gesture spike inside the continuous presenter+title-card shot and was NOT treated as a cut (merged into shot 4). Structure: live-action ECU hook with magnifying glass (cuts 1-2) -> talking-head presenter at desk with title card (cuts 3-4) -> top-down phone screen-recording walkthrough of search, certificate list, bundle pick, info entry, issuance, results and PDF export (cuts 5-6,8-11, with two live-action presenter inserts at cuts 7) -> brand sticker endcard (cut 12). Service identified as Toss 증명서 발급 (civil/government electronic certificate issuance: 주민등록등본/초본, 소득금액증명, 건강보험자격득실확인서, etc., bundleable e.g. 전세자금대출 서류 3종, exportable as PDF). On-screen captions mirror the VO verbatim and were used to correct whisper text_raw (등분->등본, 초반->초본, 소류->서류, 전세 작은 대출->전세자금대출, 연람->열람). Long-form source: 1565 frames / 52.22s at 29.97fps. Logo marks abstracted in image prompts; brand name 토스 and UI label text preserved verbatim as caption text only.

recreation_prompts.t2i_start_frame: A clean brand endcard frame, vertical 9:16, on a bright off-white paper-textured background with subtle visible paper fiber and very even soft frontal lighting. Centered slightly below the middle is a small rectangular sticker-style paper label, its corner faintly peeling as if just pressed down, carrying hand-drawn blue brush-script lettering reading 'Curator T' with a thin blue underline beneath it and, under the underline, a smaller dark Korean subtitle '토스를 발견하다' (discover Toss). The lettering has the slightly rough, sketched quality of a marker or brush on paper. There is no person and no device in the frame; the entire image is a flat graphic composition. Foreground: the Curator T paper sticker; midground: empty; background: the off-white paper field. Lighting: flat, bright, even and diffuse at a neutral 5500K, with only a faint soft shadow at the peeling sticker edge to give it dimension; low clean contrast. Lens, framing and angle: a flat straight-on graphic view, no perspective, the sticker centered with generous white space above and below. Composition: minimal and centered, a single small branded sticker as the hero on a large clean paper field, restful after a busy tutorial. Color palette and strategy: off-white paper dominant (#F4F4F2) with a single saturated brand-blue accent (#2C4FE0) in the lettering, a dark subtitle (#1B1B1F), a light grey sticker paper (#E8E8E6) and a faint blue tint (#C9D2F5); minimal saturation overall with the blue mark as the sole accent. Surfaces and texture: matte paper sticker, brush-ink lettering, off-white paper grain, subtle fibers. Atmosphere: a calm clean brand sign-off. Post and signature look: clean neutral grade, a hint of paper grain, no vignette, no HDR, no photographic depth of field. Preserve the exact lettering 'Curator T' and the Korean subtitle '토스를 발견하다' verbatim and crisp. Additional production context for fidelity: this endcard is deliberately the visual opposite of the busy screen-recording that precedes it - where those frames were dense, bright UI on warm leather, this is almost empty, a large quiet paper field with a single small hand-made mark at its centre, giving the eye a place to rest as the video resolves. The paper background should have a genuine off-white stationery feel with faint visible fibres and the slightly uneven warmth of real cardstock under soft even light, never a flat digital gradient or a pure clinical white. The sticker itself reads as a physical peel-and-stick label: a subtly rougher rectangular patch with a faint die-cut edge and one corner lifting just enough to throw a hairline soft shadow, the lettering applied in a confident but human blue brush or marker stroke that varies slightly in weight, with the thin underline drawn by the same hand and the small Korean subtitle set neatly beneath it. Keep the colour discipline minimal and intentional: the off-white paper dominates, a single saturated brand-blue carries the lettering and underline, the subtitle sits in near-black, and only a whisper of light-blue tint appears anywhere else; there should be no competing colours, no photographic depth of field, no glossy reflections, no three-dimensional bevel and no drop-shadow drama. The overall impression is craft, calm and trust - a tidy hand-stamped sign-off that leaves the brand name and its tagline as the last clean thing the viewer sees, the friendly button on the end of a helpful how-to. Center the sticker slightly below the midline with generous paper above and below, and render every glyph sharp. Style anchor: contemporary Korean short-form brand-endcard design, hand-crafted paper-sticker aesthetic; the wordmark here is the intended in-scene brand text rendered as hand-drawn lettering, while any other logo marks or symbols are kept generic.
